value.rationale: The strict difference between FIK and IK is a central natural frame-semantic issue. Counting every allowable accessibility relation on a minimally branching order yields a complete infinite-parameter classification and proves that additional incomparable leaves each asymptotically halve the proportion satisfying the stronger condition. These are meaningful exact, robust quantities rather than arbitrary slices or recitations of known correspondence theorems.
